mapper.select: SELECT id, alarm_id, dispatch_rule_id, recipient_id, recipient_name, recipient_phone, channel, title, content, status, send_time, error_msg, create_time, source_type, source_id, read_time FROM alarm_notification WHERE alarm_id = #{alarmId} ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm_notification (alarm_id, dispatch_rule_id, recipient_id, recipient_name, recipient_phone, channel, title, content, status, create_time) VALUES (#{alarmId}, #{dispatchRuleId}, #{recipientId}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{channel}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{createTime})

mapper.select: SELECT id, source_type, source_id, title, content, recipient_name, read_time, create_time, channel, dispatch_rule_id, status FROM alarm_notification WHERE recipient_id = #{userId} AND channel = 'SYSTEM' AND source_type IN ('threshold', 'comprehensive', 'offline') AND read_time IS NULL ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
